title: Permanent–Ampère equation
plain: Monge–Ampère sets the Hessian determinant to 1, and Jörgens showed its entire convex solutions are quadratics. Swap the determinant for the permanent.
math: Let $u\in C^4(\mathbb R^2)$ satisfy $u_{xx}u_{yy}+u_{xy}^2=1$, $u_{xx}>0$, $2u_{xy}^2<1$ everywhere (ellipticity). Prove or disprove that $u$ is a quadratic polynomial.
